title: ‘60 Minutes’ Prepares for a High-Pressure Premiere After Its Turbulent Shake-Up
summary: Nick Bilton, the new executive producer, has begun to put his stamp on the show. Up first: an exclusive interview with an officer who was aboard the F-15 fighter shot down over Iran.
